rows.claim: Breakfast cereal must contain no more than 6 grams of added sugars per dry ounce.
A breakfast cereal whose label shows 6 grams of added per dry ounce passes the label check and is creditable as a grain.
Yogurt must contain no more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces.
A yogurt whose label shows 12 grams of added per 6 ounces passes the label check and is creditable as a meat alternate.
rows.rule: Yogurt with no more than 12 grams of added sugars per 6 ounces is creditable as a meat alternate.

rows.claim: At least one grain served in a day must be whole grain-rich.
rows.rule: The daily whole grain-rich requirement is met if and only if at least one whole grain-rich grain was served that day.

rows.claim: Juice counts as a fruit or vegetable component only once a day.
rows.rule: Juice served at a second meal or snack in the same day does not credit toward the vegetable or fruit component.

rows.claim: For children aged 1-2: Whole milk, unflavoured.
For children aged 3-5: Low fat or fat free, unflavoured.
Unflavored whole milk is not creditable as fluid milk for a child aged 3 to 5.
For children aged 6-12: Low fat or fat free. Flavoured milk allowed for 6 and older.
For children aged 13-18: Low fat or fat free. Flavoured milk allowed.
A reimbursable breakfast for a child must contain: milk, grain, fruit or vegetable.
rows.rule: if mealType is equal to MealType_BREAKFAST and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true

rows.claim: A meat or meat alternate may replace the grain at breakfast up to three times a week.
rows.rule: A meat or meat alternate may replace the entire grains component at breakfast when it has done so at most twice earlier this week.

rows.claim: A reimbursable lunch for a child must contain: milk, fruit, vegetable, grain, meat alt.
rows.rule: if mealType is equal to MealType_LUNCH and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true

rows.claim: A second fruit may be served in place of the vegetable.
A reimbursable supper for a child must contain: milk, fruit, vegetable, grain, meat alt.
rows.rule: if mealType is equal to MealType_SUPPER and isMealReimbursable is true, then containsFluidMilk is true

rows.claim: A second fruit may be served in place of the vegetable.
A reimbursable snack for a child must contain any 2 of the five components.
Juice and milk cannot be the only two components at snack.
Yoghurt must be under 12g of added sugars per 6oz.
Cereal must be under 6g of added sugars per dry ounce.
Yoghurt must be under 12g of added sugars per 6oz.
Cereal must be under 6g of added sugars per dry ounce.
rows.rule: The breakfast cereal sugar limit is measured in added sugars, not total sugars; the former total sugars limit no longer applies.
